Summary: Extends ConstantFolding to be more aggressive and more APFloat-aware for floating-point constants, while also broadening GEP/load constant propagation. The patch changes scalar FP folding helpers to carry APFloat operands through semantic checks instead of immediately collapsing to double, updates min/max/copysign and other libcall-style folds to accept more floating-point kinds, and tightens poison handling in vector reductions. evidence: Changes CGSCC analysis invalidation and IPO pass behavior, which is far from ConstantFolding/APFloat crash paths.

features: NewPM analysis invalidation, CGSCC pipeline, IPO pass rerun behavior
selection.diff_summary:
Summary: Reverts a NewPM CGSCC analysis-invalidation optimization and restores broader invalidation/recompute behavior across function-level analyses. The revert removes FunctionStatusAnalysis-based caching shortcuts, changes CGSCC SCC-range handling back to conservative invalidation, and rewires several IPO passes so they report changed functions more directly or return none instead of selectively preserving analyses. FunctionAttrs is refactored to return boolean change flags from attribute-inference helpers, and ArgumentPromotion/Inliner-related invalidation behavior is adjusted accordingly. The net effect is more aggressive invalidation and rerunning of function analyses/passes in CGSCC pipelines.
Mechanisms: Revert selective CGSCC analysis invalidation optimization; Restore conservative invalidation of function analyses in SCC transitions; Change attribute inference helpers from changed-set accumulation to boolean change reporting; Adjust IPA passes to invalidate more broadly rather than preserving per-function analyses
Touched symbols: FunctionStatusAnalysis; CGSCCToFunctionPassAdaptor::run; incorporateNewSCCRange; ArgumentPromotionPass::run; addReadAttrs; addArgumentReturnedAttrs; addArgumentAttrs; addNoAliasAttrs
Risk relevance: Changes analysis invalidation and pass rerun behavior in CGSCC pipelines, which can expose pass-manager or transform-order bugs; Touches IPO passes that affect function attributes and interprocedural simplification decisions; Reverting a previous optimization can change whether stale analysis state is reused, potentially masking or exposing crashes
Build risk: Broad API/return-type changes across multiple IPO helpers and pass entry points; Modifies test expectations in ThinLTO/NewPM pipeline traces and inline invalidation tests; Potentially increases compile-time/runtime due to more frequent invalidation and recomputation
